SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'week', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('total', count(*), 'with_reason', count(reason),
          'incorrect', count(*) FILTER (WHERE verdict = 'incorrect'),
          'reviewers', count(DISTINCT given_by)) FROM feedback WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days'),
 'prev', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('total', count(*),
          'incorrect', count(*) FILTER (WHERE verdict = 'incorrect'))
          FROM feedback WHERE created_at > now() - interval '14 days' AND created_at <= now() - interval '7 days'),
 'coverage', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('reviewed', count(DISTINCT signal_id),
              'total', (SELECT count(*) FROM signals)) FROM feedback),
 'lessons', (SELECT count(*) FROM accounts WHERE feedback_summary IS NOT NULL),
 'top_accounts', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(x) FROM (
    SELECT a.name, count(*)::int AS n FROM feedback f JOIN accounts a ON a.id = f.account_id
    WHERE f.created_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3) x), '[]'::jsonb)
) AS ctx;
